User Story

 

As a system user

I want to be able to update liability's data

So that I will have possibility to correct and update information

 

Design: Liability (adobe.com)

Acceptance criteria:

  1.  Check system user permissions to see edit icon on Customer Liability's listing/detail page. If no such permission, edit icon will be disabled

    1. Editing Customer Liability

      1. Allows to edit all customer liabilities in the system

  2. Clicking on an edit icon on customer liability's listing or detail page will allow edit mode

  3. Customer liability amount can not be zero

  4. Based on liability’s state different logics should apply for editing:

    1. Liability is manually /via mass import created

    2. Liability is automatically created

    3. Liability is created(doesn’t matter automatically or manually) - after at least one offsetting is happened for this liability

Fields

manually created / via mass import - before offsetting

automatically created - before offsetting

after offsetting

  1. Number

  2. Creation date

  3. Date of full offset

  4. Offsetting

  5. Outgoing document

not editable

not editable

not editable

  2. Due date

  3. Initial amount

  4. Amount without interest

  5. currency

  6. accounting period

  7. outgoing document from an external system

  8. basis for issuing

  9. number of income account

  10. cost center/controlling order

  11. direct debit (bank, bic iban)

  12. Customer

  13. billing group

  14. Alternative recipient of an invoice

  2. current amount

  1. Edit Blocked for payment

  4. Edit Blocked for liabilities offsetting

  5. Edit Blocked for supply termination

If user does not have such permissions, checkboxes should be disabled (related fields should stay disabled as well - Blocked from date, Blocked to date, Reason and Additional Information)

    If user does not have such permissions, checkboxes should be disabled (related fields should stay disabled as well - Blocked from date, Blocked to date, Reason and Additional Information)

  1. Edit Blocked for payment

  2. Edit Blocked for reminder letters

  3. Edit Blocked for calculation of late payment fines/interests

  4. Edit Blocked for liabilities offsetting

  5. Edit Blocked for supply termination


    If user does not have such permissions, checkboxes should be disabled (related fields should stay disabled as well - Blocked from date, Blocked to date, Reason and Additional Information)

  1. Applicable Interest Rate

  2. Interest Date From

  3. Interest Date to

Editable

Editable

  3. Clicking on 'Save' button will update customer liability

    1. System will check all validations and if successful will save changes, else error

  4. When clicking on 'Cancel' or 'X' button should check changes and if there are changes made then warning pop-up message comes out with button: 'Your changes are not saved, are you sure you want to cancel?' Yes/No

    1. Yes - will close customer liability's editing page and return to listing page

    2. No - will close warning pop-up and stay on customer liability's editing page

    3. Warning message should be managed from the system settings

  5. Audit Log should be created

Customer feedbacks
